name: Stortebeker
source:
The leader of the Libertalia Pirates, based in the Baltic Sea.

A heavy drinker who loves buying drinks for others. It appears that she sells all the treasure she acquires for cash to buy alcohol, but it seems she has saved up a certain amount in a secret location.

"Treat him to our life!"
